banks.name: Asian Development Bank
banks.coverage_notes: IATI Registry activity files (one per recipient country/region, publisher 'asdb'). The official CSV download (data.adb.org) sits behind Cloudflare bot-challenge protection that also blocks headless-browser automation; this IATI channel is unprotected and official. Confirmed live (2026-09-15): ADB never names the financing window behind an activity -- 0 of 3,498 carry a Funding-role <participating-org> -- so funding_window is blank throughout and AsDF cannot be separated out by name. It does disclose <default-flow-type> on 100% of them (1,742 ODA / 1,750 OOF), which is what concessional is derived from; that split checks out by country (China 271 OOF vs 8 ODA, Nepal 123 ODA vs 2 OOF, Bangladesh genuinely mixed at 148/86). This is also substantively right rather than a gap: ADB folded AsDF's lending operations into its ordinary capital in 2017, so there is no longer an AsDF lending entity to attribute a loan to. Since 2026-09-16 the official 'ADB Sovereign Projects' file (as of 2026-01-27) and the Statement of Loans (as of 2017-12-31) in 'online pulled data/' are the backbone (see official_sources.json): one row per ADB project number, sovereign projects including technical assistance from the official file (IATI covered only 2,084 of its 7,106 in-scope projects and almost nothing before 2006), loans from the statement that the project file lacks, and IATI activities merged into their project. IATI operations missing from the sovereign file are kept as non-sovereign.

banks.name: Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank
banks.coverage_notes: Published AIIB project list; detail availability varies by project. Checked against a 2026-09-16 print of the approved-projects list (official_sources.json); founded 2016, so earlier years are not covered.

banks.name: African Development Bank
banks.coverage_notes: IATI Registry activity files (one per recipient country/region, publisher 'afdb'). The official MapAfrica CSV export sits behind Cloudflare bot-challenge protection that also blocks headless-browser automation; this IATI channel is unprotected and official. Confirmed live (2026-09-15): AfDB names the financing window behind every activity (100% of 5,498 carry a Funding-role <participating-org>), so the AfDB/AfDF split this file previously buried is recoverable in full -- AfDF only 2,801, AfDB ordinary capital only 1,289, both 144, an AfDB-administered special fund only 1,264. Its own <default-flow-type> is NOT used for concessionality and must not be: it tags 799 of those 1,289 ordinary-capital activities as ODA, contradicting the window data. Since 2026-09-16 the official MapAfrica project list (retrieved 2026-09-16, 3,917 operations with USD commitments and the ADB/ADF/Blend window) is the backbone; IATI (5,498 activities, 3,529 matched) fills extra fields. AfDB removed 108 activities from its IATI files between 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-15; they cannot be recovered from IATI because the files are overwritten in place.

banks.name: Arab Bank for Economic Development in Africa
banks.coverage_notes: The interactive map is a Tableau Public embed with no plain HTML/JSON listing and no IATI Registry presence. Its 'pie' worksheet's initial (unfiltered) vizql payload discloses financing totals bucketed by country/beneficiary, sector classification, and approval year, at one-decimal-place (millions of USD) precision -- not individually identified projects; no project name or ID is disclosed. Nothing after 2022 is disclosed (coverage_end_year 2022).

banks.name: Central American Bank for Economic Integration
banks.coverage_notes: CABEI/BCIE IATI open-data package; resource coverage follows the publisher's package. The 'All Projects CSV' (actividades-web.csv) has only 167 operations, almost none before 2015. Since 2026-09-16 the 'prestamos' package's public-sector loan approvals (1962-2026, no ids) are added wherever the project list has no match (same country and year, amount within 1% or a near-identical name), and its private-sector approvals, disclosed only as country-year totals, are written to cabei_private_approvals_country_year.csv.

banks.name: Development Bank of Latin America and the Caribbean
banks.coverage_notes: IATI Registry activity file (publisher 'caf'). CAF's public project portfolio page (caf.com/es/proyectos/) is protected site-wide by Incapsula bot-challenge that also blocks headless-browser automation; this IATI channel is unprotected and official. Confirmed live (2026-08-24): the file's earliest activities are approved 2006; nothing from 2002-2005 is published here -- a genuine gap in what CAF backfilled into IATI, not a scraping limitation. CAF replaces its IATI file wholesale: the 2026-09-09 republication (286 activities) dropped 226 in-scope projects, mostly completed, that the 2025-10-10 file (478) still had. Five earlier files (2024-08-14, 2024-12-30, 2025-04-02, 2025-05-15, 2025-10-10) are kept gzipped in data/caf_iati_archive/ and merged in behind the live file (532 projects in 2002-2026). Coverage still averages ~25 projects a year, below CAF's real approvals.

banks.name: Caribbean Development Bank
banks.coverage_notes: CDB's own page text: 'This map shows a selection of capital projects approved during the period 2013-2026... to gain access to the Bank's project archive' [contact CDB directly]. Confirmed live (2026-08-24): almost nothing before 2013 is listed here (one lone 2007 project) -- CDB's public map deliberately excludes most of its pre-2013 history, it is not a pagination cap or scraping gap; older projects would require CDB's separate, unlinked project archive. Also confirmed live (2026-08-24): despite the page text's own claimed 2013-2026 range, nothing newer than 2023 is published here either -- the listing has exactly 94 project links, matching what this scraper retains exactly, so 2024-2026 is currently just empty at the source, not a scraping gap. The map lists only projects under implementation (100% 'Under Implementation' on 2026-09-16), so completed CDB projects are absent; coverage_start_year/coverage_end_year mark 2013-2023 as the covered window. CDB's IATI feed (publisher 'caribank', 53 activities) is smaller still. Amounts: project pages show a bare '$' (e.g. '$ 77,708,000' for Belize's 6th Road project, checked 2026-09-16); CDB lends in US dollars, so default_currency is USD -- without it all 94 amounts had no currency and could not be converted.

banks.name: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development
banks.coverage_notes: Official project-level workbook generated by the EBRD portfolio's Download control. Confirmed live (2026-08-25): the workbook's own 'List' sheet states '€ million at reported rates unless specified' directly above its column headers -- amounts are EUR. No status column is disclosed at all; the workbook is titled 'Net Cumulative Bank Investment' and defined in its own glossary as 'stock of all commitments made', so status is inferred as Signed (see ebrd.py) rather than left blank. Amounts: the workbook's cells are plain numbers in euros with up to three decimals (e.g. 245863069.515 for the Trans Adriatic Pipeline); without amount_period_is_decimal a three-decimal value was read as thousands grouping, inflating EBRD's 2002-2026 total about tenfold (found 2026-09-16).

banks.name: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development
banks.coverage_notes: World Bank Projects search API v3, filtered to projects with a genuine IBRD commitment (current commitment > 0, or a IBRD loan/credit in the Finances One statement of loans). Confirmed live (2026-09-16): the v2 endpoint stopped updating on 2024-12-20 and listed far fewer projects per year than the Bank's own records (IDA 2014: 155 vs 251); v3 matches the official 'World Bank Projects' Excel export and Finances One year by year. loan_amount is the original approved principal from Finances One (falling back to the API's current commitment, with a note); total_commitment is the current commitment after cancellations.

banks.name: International Development Association
banks.coverage_notes: World Bank Projects search API v3, filtered to projects with a genuine IDA commitment (current commitment > 0, or a IDA loan/credit in the Finances One statement of credits, grants and guarantees). Confirmed live (2026-09-16): the v2 endpoint stopped updating on 2024-12-20 and listed far fewer projects per year than the Bank's own records (IDA 2014: 155 vs 251); v3 matches the official 'World Bank Projects' Excel export and Finances One year by year. loan_amount is the original approved principal from Finances One (falling back to the API's current commitment, with a note); total_commitment is the current commitment after cancellations.

banks.name: Inter-American Development Bank
banks.coverage_notes: English IDB Projects Dataset covering sovereign and non-sovereign operations. The dataset's newest approval is 2025-10-16 (checked 2026-09-16), so 2026 approvals are not yet included. The scope filter uses the approval year; it used to use the signing year, which kept 459 operations approved before 2002.

banks.name: International Monetary Fund
banks.coverage_notes: IMF lending arrangements, not MDB investment projects; amounts are normally reported in SDR.

banks.name: Islamic Development Bank
banks.coverage_notes: IATI Registry activity files (IsDB proper plus its ITFC trade-finance arm, publisher 'isdb'). The approvals data platform (data.isdb.org) only exposes dashboard-aggregate JSON, not a per-project list; this IATI channel is unprotected and official. Since 2026-09-16 the official 'IsDB Group Approvals' list (as of 2026-06-30, 1,905 operations, no ids) is the backbone for IsDB's own operations, matched to IATI by country, year and name; ITFC trade finance, which that list omits, is kept from IATI as instrument_category trade_finance. IATI IsDB activities with no match (often older projects dated by a later commitment) are listed in reports/isdb_reconciliation.csv.

banks.name: New Development Bank
banks.coverage_notes: NDB published project cards and detail pages. Founded 2015; first approvals 2016.

banks.name: European Investment Bank
banks.coverage_notes: eib.org's Cloudflare block documented 2026-08-25 (which forced an earlier switch to EIB's thin IATI Registry activity file, only 1,395 activities) is no longer in effect as of 2026-09-03 -- confirmed live, along with several other bank domains that flipped between blocked/reachable over the course of this project's development. EIB's real project database is this plain, unauthenticated JSON API its own 'All projects' page calls, reporting ~17,000 projects with no filter (roughly matching an independent 18,052 count for 2002-2026), a ~12x jump from the old IATI-derived figure. Trade-off, accepted deliberately: this source has no IATI-shaped <participating-org>/<loan-terms> disclosure, so cofinancing_partners and interest_rate/last_repayment_date are not available here (they were previously populated via the IATI file) -- 12x more real projects is the clear right trade. If eib.org's block returns, the IATI mirror (https://bulk-data.iatistandard.org/eib/eib-act.xml) remains a documented fallback, just a materially incomplete one.
